open_findings: F-002 / F-019 OPEN, MEASURED, MUST NOT BE TUNED AWAY: false interventions are 91.08% against a 2% target. Broken out by stakes: 0% below Rs.100, 100% above. NOT detector noise -- at Rs.40,000 impact with a 2.5x reversibility multiplier, L0_pass only wins if P(defect) < ~0.0001, and the detector's floor on clean text is ~0.019. 'false interventions <= 2%' and 'impact_inr: 40000 with lambda_time 0.40' cannot both hold. The live question is the IMPACT MODEL: impact_inr is a per-request stake charged in full to every sentence, so a five-sentence answer is charged five times the harm the request can cause. Three defensible resolutions (discount per sentence / raise lambda_time / re-target the metric per stakes band); choosing is a deliberate decision, not a tuning pass. LIVE EVIDENCE 2026-08-26: Scene 1 against the real engine on real Ollama produced L5_block (loss Rs.241.89, runner-up L4_hold) on the sentence 'When prepaying a floating-rate home loan, the applicable charge depends on your loan agreement.' -- a hedged, non-committal, essentially harmless answer. Nothing was delivered to the customer. THIS IS DEMO-BLOCKING: the flagship scene currently blocks a reasonable answer, and it is the same root cause as the 91% false-intervention rate rather than a separate bug.

F-020 OPEN: `make eval` models generation latency and billing rather than observing them, and models no cache saving at all. The -20.15% net spend figure is routing + loop-breaking only. Stated in the harness output, not just in docs.

F-021 OPEN, OPERATIONAL, DEMO-BLOCKING: the router sends high-stakes traffic to the strong tier (qwen3:8b, 6.6 GiB) and on this laptop that model does not always fit -- Ollama returns a hard 500 ('model requires more system memory') and the customer gets NO answer at all. The gateway handles it correctly (in-band error chunk, clean [DONE], ledger row) but 'correctly reports a total failure' is not good enough for the high-stakes path, which is exactly the traffic the router sends there. Needs an explicit, RECORDED capacity fallback: retry on the cheap tier and mark the response degraded. Must NOT be a silent reroute -- answering with a different model than the one selected, without saying so, breaks the property that makes the ledger's spend numbers meaningful. Discovered by live verification after the engine swap; no test covers it because respx fixtures never run out of memory.
